verdict.rationale: A live probe found an llms.txt at docs.usebruno.com that indexes Markdown versions of the docs, and many doc pages are served as .md URLs. Bruno also publishes agent-oriented integration guides for Cursor, VS Code Copilot and Codex, including advice to add an AGENTS.md so agents know how to work with Bruno collections. missing for 10: no evidence of a full-content llms-full.txt variant, no independent or community confirmation of agents consuming these docs successfully.
